## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important defect needs fixing: `select_failures` matches report paths without normalizing them, so it drops a failed test whose report path starts with `./`. This review read all of `app/selection.py` and `tests/test_selection.py` and compared the new selector with `select_explicit` and `select_cached`. No tests were run. Rewriting `_select_normalized` as a list comprehension and pulling `normalized` into its own variable in `select_cached` leaves their behavior unchanged.

## Changes
The pull request adds `select_failures`, which picks requested paths from a runner report's `"failed"` list. It also refactors `select_cached` and `_select_normalized` without changing what they do, and adds tests for all three selectors.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize report paths before matching in select_failures — A report of `{"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` with `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}` returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. The new code checks `path in requested` on the raw report path, while `select_explicit` (`app/selection.py:6`) checks `normalize(path) in requested` and keeps the original spelling, which is the behavior the docstring "preserving its original spelling" describes. The only test (`tests/test_selection.py:42-44`) uses report paths without the `./` prefix, so nothing exercises this case. — When a runner writes `./`-prefixed paths, failed tests are silently left out of the selection and do not rerun, with no error or log to show it. — Fix: Use `[path for path in report["failed"] if normalize(path) in requested]`, matching `select_explicit`, and add a test with a `./`-prefixed report entry.
